notes.title: Nullum Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
New version available with resizable window and some improvements due to an update on the game engine used.
Cheers!

notes.title: Windowed Mode Added
notes.content:
Thanks for your nice reviews!
I've added the option to switch into Windowed Mode.
You can find a new button in the three bars menu to change modes.
Thanks for playing!
